steps.text: Good, now I have everything I need. I can see the invoice text from the image. Let me run OCR and create the Excel file:

tool_input_args.name: command
tool_input_args.value:
python3 << 'EOF'
import subprocess, os

# Run tesseract OCR on the invoice image
result = subprocess.run(
    ["tesseract", "/workspace/testbed/images/invoice.png", "stdout"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
ocr_text = result.stdout.strip()
print("OCR Output:")
print(ocr_text)

# Parse the OCR text into structured data
import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice"

# Write headers
ws["A1"] = "Field"
ws["B1"] = "Value"
ws["A1"].font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True)
ws["B1"].font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True)

# Parse each line
row = 2
for line in ocr_text.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    if ":" in line:
        field, value = line.split(":", 1)
        ws[f"A{row}"] = field.strip()
        ws[f"B{row}"] = value.strip()
    else:
        # e.g. "Invoice #1042"
        ws[f"A{row}"] = line
        ws[f"B{row}"] = ""
    row += 1

# Auto-size columns
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 20
ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 25

output_path = "/workspace/invoice.xlsx"
wb.save(output_path)

# Set file ownership to the current user
print(f"\nSaved to: {output_path}")
EOF
